description: Welcome your little one in timeless style with the Addison Crib, a centerpiece designed to grow with your family. Crafted from solid hardwood with a rich Brown Maple finish, this 4-in-1 convertible crib transforms easily from crib to toddler bed, daybed, and full-size bed — offering years of use and cherished memories. Three adjustable mattress positions let you lower the mattress as your baby begins to sit and stand, giving you peace of mind at every stage. The clean, classic silhouette with gently arched details fits beautifully in any nursery, from modern farmhouse to traditional. All finishes are baby-safe, non-toxic, and tested to meet or exceed CPSC and ASTM safety standards. The Addison coordinates effortlessly with the full Addison collection of dressers, chests, and nightstands for a cohesive, dreamy nursery you'll love spending time in. Assembly is straightforward with all hardware included.
